title: Hearty American Epoisses Casserole
description: A rich and satisfying American casserole featuring the bold flavors of epoisses cheese, crispy fried onions, and savory ground beef, perfect for a comforting meal prep dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the flour to the skillet and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Gradually stir in the beef broth and milk, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook, stirring occasionally, until it has thickened slightly.
Stir in the crumbled epoisses cheese until it is fully melted and the mixture is smooth.
Add the frozen peas and carrots, salt, and pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with the fried onions.
Dot the top of the casserole with the unsalted butter.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
